presets.title: General
presets.what: The everyday preset: questions, writing, checking things, your own paperwork - one balanced setup instead of a separate admin preset.
presets.cost: qwen3.5:9b sits on the 2060 and holds 196,608 tokens there, taking 9.17 of its 12 GB; nothing else fits beside it. Writing is 44.9 tokens a second, not the fastest.
presets.worse: Not the quickest and not the picture specialist; its thinking has to stay off for ordinary turns, or it answered nothing in the measured run.

presets.title: Coding
presets.what: For writing and fixing code, reading a project, and long tool-driven coding jobs: the 2060 keeps the best measured model at 196k, and the coding lane starts on demand when the job needs a second worker.
presets.cost: The 2060's 44.9 tokens a second is slower than the fast card, and it spends 9.17 of 12 GB, so the second model lives on the other card.
presets.worse: The coding lane is on the smaller display card (8 GB); it is started for a coding job and is not the everyday lane.

presets.title: Agentic + Vision
presets.focus: tools, steps, forms, browser, phone, pictures
presets.what: For work that takes several steps with tools - browser, phone, forms, notes - and pictures: the vision model reads the image, and a picture-capable model stays off the display card.
presets.cost: NOT MEASURED for this model on this PC. Its context is planned at 16,384, and pictures take longer than text; no speed figure is claimed until it is measured.
presets.worse: Unmeasured: nothing here says it is faster or better than the general preset, and it is not the everyday choice.

presets.title: Fast
presets.what: The quickest preset: qwen3:8b on the fast card at 16k, while the 2060 keeps the general model warm for when you switch back.
presets.cost: 16,384 tokens is its ceiling and it is the weakest measured explainer; the 2060's model stays loaded beside it, for the same measured -1.9% off the main model's speed.
presets.worse: Weakest answer quality of the measured models and the shortest conversation; chosen for waiting less, not for care.
